content: Ludi I Awanun Bowasa Elana Ni Alolonan
Sauga etega abwe Naomi i baek Ludi elana i ba, “Yawau, wam abamina etegana na loyaan ge eliyana nu mibubun.
He Bowasa toto wana galokau alomwau ku tuwatuwalali, iya lagou tutuna etega. Nasi bulina bali enona alona ge musana ni ase ana abaasiasi elana.
Nu na nu highig, tuwam nu paenonu, ge kaliko waiwaisana nu galoi. Inoke nu na bali musana ana abaasiasi elana, yaa bahi Bowasa ni kikitewa ana siga ni anan ge ni im haba.
Nu kite bubun ga i kekenuwa. Sauga ebo iyaka ni kenu mati, inoke nu na aenaa habobu nu gabom pasikal, yaka nu kenu. Iya abwe ni baewa elam hauna nu ginol.”
Yaka anana Ludi i lahe i ba, “Na ginol ni ola wam baaba.”
Inoke Ludi i na bali musana ana abaasiasi elana ge bugul gegewena toto yawana i baunan eliyana i ginol.
Sauga Bowasa i anan ge i im haba, yaka amnana i waisi, inoke i na i kenu bali enowana ana pwahin buhunaa. Yaka Ludi i nokekei i na Bowasa aenaa habobu i gabom pasikal ge i tal kenu.
Bulin nuwana Bowasa atena i you, yaka i kul pil yova etega i kite i kenukenu aena gegelinaa.
Inoke i nel i ba, “Henala owa?”Bowasa alona Ludi hi liwaliwan Anana i lahe i ba, “Tonowak, nau Ludi. Am habobu buhuna u anal u pahabobuwau,
kaiwena owa topwapwamola pasikal etegana kaiwema.”
Yaka Bowasa i ba, “Yehoba ni muloluagiwa. Nunuwana toto u ginol sauga ya i bwata lake toto valila u ginola Naomi elana. Kaiwena nige hevalau, ebo togulagula o ebo towasawasa, u loloyaagil.
He bahi nu nuwanuwatu. Na ginol ni ola wam awanun. Kaiwena panuwa ya ana tomina gegewel hi atena owa yova toto wana pagan sasapona.
Tunahot nau topwapwamola pasikal etegana, yaa etegana al iyoho i gan, iya Elimeleki ana tiniya hot, nau tini kekeisi.

Bulin e nu kenuwa ga te. Bwaligumwa mweluluga iya na hago ga. Ebo nuwana ni ginol ni ola pwapwamola pasikal ana ginol, he i waisi. Yaa ebo nigeya, he ya bateli Yehoba yawalina gaganina alanaa, nau na ginol. He u kenuwa te ana siga mweluluga.”

Inoke Ludi i kenuwa Bowasa aena gegelinaa ana siga mweluluga. Panuwa nigeya ga i mwamwananal hot ge i bosowaina gamagal ali awa ta kite bubun, yaka Ludi i lut, kaiwena Bowasa i ba, “Bahi gamagalau nihi atena te u kenuwa e.”

Yaka Bowasa i baek Ludi elana i ba, “Am kaliko babalona tultul kaiwena u ahem ge u anal hiwe.” Sauga i ginol ola, inoke Bowasa bali ana bwata kelaubwa tuwenti kiloglem (20 kg) i ligin kaliko pwatanaa ge i patoun. Inoke Ludi i sikal ni na wana panuwaa.
Sauga i vin, inoke Naomi i neli i ba, “Yawau, wam nawanawa wasana ga i ola?” Inoke bugul gegewena toto Bowasa i ginol eliyana i wasaan.
Yaka i ba vevehe al i ba, “Bowasa i baem eliyau, ‘Bahi enoenovam nu sisikal yawam eliyana.’ Yaka bali hiwe, ana bwata kelaubwa tuwenti kiloglem, i pem.”
Inoke Naomi i ba, “Yawau, u matamatan ga ana siga ta kite hauna gun ni masal. Lan ebe Bowasa nige ni babakuhu ana siga am logugui ni pasapu.”

footnotes.text: Baaba bali ge witi nu kitel Baaba Ona ali Sapu ana Abaloya lamwa xxx ge xxx. Witi enona alona ge musana hi asiasi kakanununa iyoho Bateli Vavaluna lamwa 140 i awoni.

Baaba ya ba kakanun, ana sapu te alolon bana. He Ludi ana sapu i gan bosowaina ni awanun ola. Isileli wali logugui etegana i ola hiwe. Ebo tau etega ni aliga nige natuna, tutuna etega tau ana giba ni alolonan. Sauga yova o ni ab, wawaya tau toto i alaliga alana ni milili tage iya natuna. Yaka wawaya o abwe toto i alaliga wana bilibili ge wana bugubugul ni ahe ni matahikan (Logugui Labuina 25:5-10).
